EDITABLE PROJECT AND VALIDATION REFERENCE

Expected authored output (not generated by the analyzer):
  Project.pbip
  Project.SemanticModel/
    definition.pbism             version 4.0+ for TMDL
    definition/
      database.tmdl             supported compatibility level
      model.tmdl                model properties and object references
      tables/*.tmdl             columns, measures, explicit M partitions
      expressions.tmdl          approved non-secret M parameters if needed
      relationships.tmdl        reviewed grain/cardinality/directions if needed
      roles/*.tmdl              only approved security policies if needed
  Project.Report/
    definition.pbir             version 4.0+, relative byPath model binding
    definition/
      version.json
      report.json               ENHANCED PBIR, not legacy root report.json
      pages/pages.json
      pages/<id>/page.json
      pages/<id>/visuals/<id>/visual.json
  migration-review.json          all mappings, approvals, gate evidence
  review.txt                     human-readable limitations/acceptance report

No model.bim or PBIR-Legacy fallback. A root report.json without an enhanced
definition/ tree does not meet this skill's contract.
Credentials and local .pbi/cache files are not migration artifacts.
Fabric item .platform files are deployment-specific; do not fabricate workspace
identities, publish, or change service items without separate authorization.

SELF-AUTHORED STARTER
  templates/starter/ contains two synthetic M rows, a measure and one blank
  PBIR page deliberately labeled STARTER ONLY. It has no migrated visuals.
  It demonstrates editable text structure, no external data or authentication.
  Schema-backed JSON is NOT evidence that Desktop can open/refresh it.
  No TMDL parser or Desktop round-trip was run during initial implementation.

OPTIONAL PUBLIC-SCHEMA CHECK (network access, existing optional dependency)
  python3 scripts/validate_starter_schemas.py
Requires jsonschema>=4.18 in your environment. Seven fixed starter JSON documents
are checked against official Draft-07 schemas downloaded from Microsoft's public
json-schemas repository. The script reads no workbooks, does not validate TMDL,
and does not traverse remote $refs. Internal references resolve locally.
The hashes printed identify the exact schema bytes used. Public main can change;
record these hashes and target Desktop version in real migration evidence.
For new visual/query constructs, use a full validator and a reviewed local
registry including required external schemas; do NOT disable unresolved refs.

Pinned example schema IDs (verified against public definitions):
  https://developer.microsoft.com/json-schemas/fabric/pbip/pbipProperties/1.0.0/schema.json
  https://developer.microsoft.com/json-schemas/fabric/item/semanticModel/definitionProperties/1.0.0/schema.json
  https://developer.microsoft.com/json-schemas/fabric/item/report/definitionProperties/2.0.0/schema.json
  https://developer.microsoft.com/json-schemas/fabric/item/report/definition/versionMetadata/1.0.0/schema.json
  https://developer.microsoft.com/json-schemas/fabric/item/report/definition/report/3.0.0/schema.json
  https://developer.microsoft.com/json-schemas/fabric/item/report/definition/pagesMetadata/1.0.0/schema.json
  https://developer.microsoft.com/json-schemas/fabric/item/report/definition/page/2.0.0/schema.json

Official public schema repository:
  https://github.com/microsoft/json-schemas/tree/main/fabric
For visualContainer and semanticQuery, select supported versions from:
  https://github.com/microsoft/json-schemas/tree/main/fabric/item/report/definition
Do not guess a visual schema version from the page/report version.

Microsoft format and serializer documentation:
  https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/developer/projects/projects-overview
  https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/developer/projects/projects-dataset
  https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/developer/projects/projects-report
  https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/analysis-services/tmdl/tmdl-overview?view=power-bi-premium-current
  https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/microsoft.analysisservices.tmdlserializer

Tableau official background (not a stable full TWB XML schema):
  https://help.tableau.com/current/pro/desktop/en-us/save_savework_packagedworkbooks.htm
  https://help.tableau.com/current/pro/desktop/en-us/calculations_calculatedfields_lod.htm
  https://help.tableau.com/current/pro/desktop/en-us/calculations_tablecalculations.htm
Workbook internals vary by version and feature. These scripts implement a
conservative structural subset, not an official Tableau XML schema validator.

REQUIRED GATE RECORDING
  pending  = not yet attempted; not_run = unavailable/not authorized
  passed   = evidence of THIS gate; failed = observed problem; blocked = dependency
Keep G1 coverage/privacy, G2 TMDL, G3 PBIR/schema references, G4 Desktop refresh and
G5 semantic/visual parity separate. JSON validation cannot validate DAX/M behavior,
data security, connector execution, visual correctness or Desktop compatibility.
Record exact commands/builds, error summaries without private source content,
artifacts checked, time, reviewer, and unresolved unsupported/blocked source IDs.
